title: Sampling a loaded die from a uniform draw
alt: A unit interval divided into six pieces sized by the die's probabilities; a draw at 0.42 falls in the fourth piece and outputs face 4.
caption: Cut the interval by the probabilities, then let a uniform draw pick the piece.
data_source: Loaded-die probabilities (0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.20, 0.30) from the post; segment widths are exact cumulative sums.
